ioreg_uuid_block.command:
python3 -I -c 
import re,subprocess,pathlib,json
mount='/Volumes/mac mini m4'
m=subprocess.run(["/sbin/mount"],capture_output=True,text=True)
line=next(l for l in m.stdout.splitlines() if " on "+mount+" (" in l)
dev=line.split(" on ",1)[0]
r=subprocess.run(["/usr/sbin/ioreg","-r","-c","IOMedia","-l","-w","0"],capture_output=True,text=True)
lines=r.stdout.splitlines();uuid=None;name=None;blk=[]
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    if '"BSD Name" = "'+pathlib.Path(dev).name+'"' in l:
        blk=lines[max(0,i-55):i+1]
        for x in reversed(blk):
            q=re.search(r'"UUID" = "([^"]+)"',x)
            if q and uuid is None:uuid=q.group(1)
            q=re.search(r'"FullName" = "([^"]+)"',x)
            if q and name is None:name=q.group(1)
        break
print(json.dumps({"device":dev,"bsd_name":pathlib.Path(dev).name,"media_uuid":uuid,
 "volume_name":name,"block":blk[-14:]},indent=1))

import json,os,pathlib
paths=json.loads('["/Volumes/mac mini m4/Downloads/git trees and automations", "/Volumes/mac mini m4/Downloads/git trees and automations/worktrees", "/Volumes/mac mini m4/Downloads/git trees and automations/scratch", "/Volumes/mac mini m4/Downloads/git trees and automations/tmp/purple-billboard", "/Volumes/mac mini m4/Downloads/git trees and automations/tmp/purple-billboard-caches", "/Volumes/mac mini m4/Downloads/git trees and automations/Purple-Billboard-Client-System-Build", "/Volumes/mac mini m4/Downloads/git trees and automations/worktrees/pb-skill38-20261024/b-t-04", "/Volumes/mac mini m4/Downloads/git trees and automations/worktrees/pb-skill38-20261024/b-t-04/evidence", "/Volumes/mac mini m4/Downloads/git trees and automations/scratch/pb-skill38-20261024/lanes/PBB-177-lane", "/Volumes/mac mini m4/Downloads/git trees and automations/scratch/pb-skill38-20261024/lanes/PBB-177-lane/tmp-probe", "/Volumes/mac mini m4/Downloads/git trees and automations/scratch/pb-skill38-20261024/lanes/PBB-177-lane/cache-probe"]')
mount=pathlib.Path("/Volumes/mac mini m4")
md=mount.stat().st_dev
res=[]
for p in paths:
    q=pathlib.Path(p)
    rec={"path":p,"exists":q.exists(),"is_dir":q.is_dir() if q.exists() else None}
    if q.exists():
        rec["st_dev"]=q.stat().st_dev
        rec["same_device_as_mount"]=rec["st_dev"]==md
        rec["is_symlink"]=q.is_symlink()
        rec["resolved_equals_path"]=os.path.realpath(p)==os.path.abspath(p)
        cur=pathlib.Path("/");sym=[];rebase=False
        for part in q.absolute().parts[1:]:
            cur=cur/part
            if cur.is_symlink():sym.append(str(cur))
        rec["symlink_components"]=sym
    res.append(rec)
print(json.dumps({"mount_dev":md,"paths":res},indent=1))
